headlines.title: AppLovin Soars 61% in a Week. Its CEO: Gains “Won’t Land on a Perfect Quarterly Schedule”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAppLovin stock is up 61% in the past week, lifted by a 55% jump in third-quarter revenue and a fourth-quarter forecast above estimates. Fast ad growth at Unity suggests Roblox’s user slump hasn’t hit game ad budgets, which was the worry behind AppLovin’s October low.

headlines.title: AppLovin: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors

headlines.title: APP Stock Surges 51% After Q3 Earnings: Is it Still a Buy?
headlines.summary: AppLovin shares surge 51% after strong Q3 earnings and upbeat Q4 guidance, but rising expectations and execution risks raise questions about further upside.

headlines.title: Digital Turbine Plunges 23% Despite Revenue Beat as Margins Shrink and Profit Outlook Stays Put; Unity Slides 2%, AppLovin Dips
headlines.summary: Digital Turbine beat on sales and raised its revenue target, yet investors still rushed for the exits. Behind the headline growth sit a shrinking margin, a cost restatement, and a profit forecast that refused to budge.

description: AppLovin Corporation provides end-to-end artificial intelligence-powered advertising solutions for businesses in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Advertising and Apps. The company offers Axon Ads Manager, a suite of marketing solutions that enables developers to automate, optimize, and manage marketing efforts; MAX, an in-app bidding technology that optimizes the value of a publisher's advertising inventory by running a real-time competitive auction; Adjust, a measurement and analytics marketing platform; and Wurl, a connected TV platform, which distributes streaming video for content companies, provides advertising and publishing solutions. It serves individuals, small and independent businesses, enterprises, advertisers and advertising networks, mobile app publishers, and indie studio developers. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.
